description: Approve one supporter after the creator has found the payment in their own bank app. This cannot be undone. The supporter's name and amount then show on the creator's page and stream overlays and count toward totals and the active goal; if that fills the goal, the goal is marked complete and taken off the page. With hidden set, the message and any voice recording stay private while the name and amount still show. A thank-you reply (up to 280 characters, word-filtered) can be set at the same time and replaces any existing reply. Nothing is sent to the supporter. Only the creator can know whether the money arrived, so never approve without being asked to for that specific supporter.

hidden.description: Keep the message and any voice recording private. The name and amount still show on the page.

reply.description: A thank-you shown beside them on the page, up to 280 characters. Replaces any existing reply. Refused if the word filter flags it.
